verdict.rationale: Kushki markets its own Smartlink product for creating and customizing payment links, which matches the core of the story. The evidence is only a marketing title, though. It does not show that links are made in a dashboard without code, that they can be shared, or that a merchant can start selling right away. Missing for 10: documented dashboard creation flow, explicit no-code confirmation, shareability/distribution details, onboarding-to-first-sale time, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can create a shareable payment link from the dashboard with no code and start selling immediately

citations.quote: Smartlink — Crea y personaliza links de pago
